title: 第16章 黄灿灿一大片
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 三天光阴，如白驹过隙。这三天里，辰楠过得倒是悠闲自在。每日清晨用灵泉溪水浇灌空间里的南瓜，眼看着那些金灿灿的果实一天比一天饱满。他自已也日日服用灵泉，原本羸弱的身子骨稍微结实了一些，脸色也红润了不少。白日里，他就在京城的大街小巷闲逛，细细品味这个特殊年代的独特气息。这时代的一切都是集体的，私人是没有资产的，一切都是那么的公平。至少哪怕是有钱人也会饿肚子。但若说是绝对公平，那也是不可能的。街上行人大多穿着蓝、灰、绿三色的衣裳，偶尔有骑自行车的人叮铃铃地掠过。百货大楼门口总是排着长队，人们手里紧紧攥着各种票证——粮票、布票、肉票。一切都是计划供应，一切都是集体所有。辰楠也趁机换了一些票据，给妹妹们买了新衣服、鞋子、发夹、挎包等等生活用品。这天下午，日头刚刚偏西，辰楠就提前来到了什刹海外围的小树林。他在林中慢悠悠地转了一圈，眼睛敏锐地观察着四周的动静。果然，在树林边缘，他发现了三个蹲守的汉子。虽然他们都穿着普通百姓的衣服，但那警惕的眼神和健硕的身形，一看就不是寻常路人。这都快晚上了，这树林可不会有人来。而且这三人应该是已经发现了他的踪迹。不用想也知道是罗八刀提前就派了人手来盯梢。想必是看看有没有埋伏之类的，也想看看这一万斤南瓜是不是真的。趁着黄昏时分光线昏暗，辰楠悄无声息地摸到那三人身后。经过灵泉溪水滋润的身体轻盈有力，他出手如电，三个汉子还没反应过来，就软软地倒在了地上。“你们还是好好睡一觉吧。“辰楠并没有拖拽他们，就让他们在原地休息。确认四周再无人监视后，他找到林中一片开阔的草地。意念一动，一百个硕大无比的南瓜瞬间出现在草地上。每个南瓜的体型将近石碾子那般大，金黄色的外皮在夕阳余晖下闪着诱人的光泽。最小的也有一百斤重，最大的恐怕达到了一百二十斤。辰楠看着一大堆南瓜，想了想又故意在草地上弄出几道痕迹，制造出板车运输的假象。做完这一切，他在其中最大的一个南瓜上躺下闭目养神。很快——夜幕降临。星光闪烁。树林里传来了窸窸窣窣的脚步声。伴随着许多手电光线到处晃荡着。辰楠警觉地睁开眼，借助星光看清了来人。只见罗八刀带着十来个汉子走了过来，那三个被放倒的盯梢者也跟在其中，一个个低着头，不敢与辰楠对视。手电筒有七八支，可见这些人也是有点实力。要知道这个时候的手电筒可是稀罕货，不是谁都能买到的。在乡下几乎没有手电筒，若是谁有一支手电筒，那可以拿出去炫耀吹嘘很久的。“刀哥果然守时。“辰楠从南瓜上坐了起身。罗八刀脸上的刀疤在月光下显得更加狰狞，他扫了一眼草地上堆积如山的南瓜，眼中闪过一抹震惊，但很快又恢复了平静。“辰小兄弟也很准时。“罗八刀意味深长地说，“这么多南瓜，一万斤应该是够了。“那三个被放倒的汉子面面相觑，可惜他们没看到这些南瓜是怎么运输进来的。他们昏迷了两个小时，还是其他兄弟过来才叫醒他们的。辰楠淡然一笑：“做买卖讲究的是诚信，时间有限就先验收吧。““好说，称重。”罗八刀打破了沉默，挥了挥手。周围并没有什么埋伏，看来对方真是来交易的。这是第一次大额交易，他还是很警惕的，来时就检查过了周围的环境。也正是因此，才把那三个昏迷的手下喊醒，得知了辰楠的身手应该很不错。毕竟他们三人看到辰楠来到这里，没一会他们就晕了过去，除了是辰楠动手还能有谁。辰楠虽然表面平静，但也是暗暗警惕着。这笔交易数额巨大，难保对方不会见财起意。十几个汉子立即上前，两人一组，用粗木杠抬着大秤开始称重。寂静的树林里只听见报数声和脚步声。“一百零三斤！““一百一十八斤！““九十五斤！“……辰楠站在一旁，看似随意，实则观察四周着，随时准备应对突发情况。约莫半个小时，一个管事模样的汉子走到罗八刀面前：“刀哥，总共一万零两百斤。“罗八刀点点头，挥手让小弟拿钱来。一个小弟从布包里拿出一沓钱递，随即又从自已口袋里拿出四十块钱一并递给辰楠：“辰小哥，这是两千零四十块钱。“辰楠接过厚厚一沓钱，整整齐齐的两百张“大团结“。他随手掂了掂，看也不看就塞进随身携带的挎包里，实则意念一动，钱已经进入了空间。“辰小哥你不数一下？”罗八刀见辰楠看也不看就把钱塞进挎包，不禁愣住了。他混迹黑市这么多年，还是头一次见到对这么大笔钱如此不在意的人。月光下，辰楠的脸上看不出什么表情，只是淡淡地摇头：“不用了。”罗八刀先是诧异，随即恍然大悟。这少年哪里是粗心大意，分明是胸有成竹。若是钱的数目不对，双方自然不会再有下次交易。更重要的是，这少年分明是自恃实力，根本不怕他罗八刀耍什么花招。想通这一层，罗八刀不由得对眼前这个看似普通的少年刮目相看。他混迹江湖十余年，从一个小小的街头混混做到如今的黑市大佬，见过形形色色的人。可像辰楠这般年纪就有如此魄力的，还是头一遭。“佩服。“罗八刀在心中暗叹。回想自已刚出道时，每次交易都要把钞票翻来覆去数上三遍，生怕吃一点亏。而这少年面对两千多块的巨款，竟能如此云淡风轻，这份定力着实令人惊叹。“辰楠小兄弟，”罗八刀的语气不自觉地带上几分敬意，“以后若是还有南瓜，都可以来找我。”他顿了顿，又补充道：“不仅是南瓜，只要是食物都可以。”
content_en: Three days passed like a white horse passing by.During these three days, Chen Nan lived a leisurely life.Every morning, I water the pumpkins in the space with water from the spiritual spring stream, watching the golden fruits become more plump day by day.He himself also took Lingquan every day, and the bones in his originally weak body became a little stronger, and his face became much rosier.During the day, he wandered around the streets and alleys of the capital, savoring the unique atmosphere of this special era.Everything in this era is collective, individuals have no assets, and everything is so fair.At least even rich people go hungry.But to say it is absolutely fair is impossible.Most of the pedestrians on the street wore blue, gray, and green clothes, and occasionally cyclists passed by.There is always a long queue at the door of the department store, and people are clutching various kinds of tickets - food stamps, cloth stamps, and meat stamps.Everything is planned supply and everything is collectively owned.Chen Nan also took the opportunity to exchange some bills and buy new clothes, shoes, hairpins, satchels and other daily necessities for her sisters.That afternoon, as the sun just turned westward, Chen Nan arrived at the small woods outside Shichahai in advance.He walked slowly around in the forest, his eyes keenly observing the movements around him.Sure enough, he found three men squatting at the edge of the woods.Although they were all wearing ordinary people's clothes, their alert eyes and strong bodies made them look like they were no ordinary passers-by.It's almost night, and no one will come to the woods.And these three people should have discovered his traces.You don't need to think about it to know that Luo Badao sent people to keep an eye on him in advance.He must have wanted to see if there was an ambush or something, and also wanted to see if the 10,000 kilograms of pumpkins were real.Taking advantage of the dim light at dusk, Chen Nan quietly touched behind the three people.His body, moistened by the Lingquan stream, was light and strong, and his strikes were like lightning. Before the three men could react, they fell softly to the ground."You should have a good sleep." Chen Nan did not drag them and let them rest where they were.After confirming that no one was watching around, he found an open grassland in the forest.With a thought, a hundred huge pumpkins instantly appeared on the grass.Each pumpkin is nearly as big as a stone roller, and its golden skin shines attractively in the sunset.The smallest one weighs a hundred kilograms, and the largest one probably weighs one hundred and twenty kilograms.Chen Nan looked at a large pile of pumpkins, thought for a while, and deliberately made a few traces on the grass to create the illusion of being transported by pallet truck.After doing all this, he lay down on the largest pumpkin and closed his eyes to rest.Soon - night falls.The stars twinkle.There were rustling footsteps in the woods.Along with many flashlight lights swaying everywhere.Chen Nan opened his eyes alertly and used the starlight to see the person clearly.Luo Badao was seen walking over with a dozen men, and the three stalkers who were knocked down were also among them. They all lowered their heads and did not dare to look at Chen Nan.There are seven or eight flashlights, which shows that these people are somewhat capable.You must know that flashlights at this time are rare items and not everyone can buy them.There are almost no flashlights in the countryside. If someone has a flashlight, they can show it off and brag about it for a long time."Brother Dao is indeed punctual." Chen Nan sat up from the pumpkin.The scars on Luo Badao's face looked even more ferocious in the moonlight. He glanced at the piles of pumpkins on the grass, a flash of shock flashed in his eyes, but he quickly regained his composure."Brother Chen is also very punctual." Luo Badao said meaningfully, "With so many pumpkins, ten thousand kilograms should be enough." The three men who were knocked down looked at each other, but it was a pity that they did not see how these pumpkins were transported.They were unconscious for two hours, and other brothers came to wake them up.Chen Nan smiled calmly: "Integrity is what matters when doing business. If time is limited, just check and accept it first." "Easy to say, weigh it." Luo Badao broke the silence and waved his hand.There is no ambush around, it seems that the other party is really here to trade.This was his first large-scale transaction, so he was still very vigilant and checked the surrounding environment when he came.It was precisely because of this that he woke up the three unconscious men and learned that Chen Nan should be very good at it.After all, when the three of them saw Chen Nan coming here, they fainted after a while. Who else could do it except Chen Nan.Although Chen Nan was calm on the surface, she was also secretly wary.The amount of this transaction is huge, and there is no guarantee that the other party will not take advantage of the money.A dozen men immediately stepped forward, working in pairs, using thick wooden poles to carry large scales and began weighing.The only sounds in the silent woods were the sound of counting and footsteps."One hundred and three kilograms!" "One hundred and eighteen kilograms!" "Ninety-five kilograms!"... Chen Nan stood aside, seemingly casual, but in fact he was observing his surroundings, ready to deal with emergencies at any time.About half an hour later, a man who looked like a manager walked up to Luo Badao and said, "Brother Dao, the total is 10,200 kilograms." Luo Badao nodded and waved for his younger brother to bring the money.A boy took out a wad of money from the cloth bag and handed it over, and then took out forty yuan from his pocket and handed it to Chen Nan: "Brother Chen, this is two thousand and forty yuan." Chen Nan took the thick wad of money and neatly put two hundred "Great Unity" cards.He weighed it casually and stuffed it into the satchel he carried without looking at it. In fact, with a thought, the money had already entered the space."Brother Chen, why don't you count?" Luo Badao was stunned when he saw Chen Nan stuffing the money into her bag without even looking at it.In all the years he has been in the black market, this is the first time he has seen someone so indifferent to such a large sum of money.Under the moonlight, there was no expression on Chen Nan's face. He just shook his head lightly: "No need." Luo Badao was surprised at first, and then suddenly realized.This young man wasn't careless, he was clearly very confident.If the amount of money is wrong, the two parties will naturally not have another transaction.What's more important is that this young man clearly relies on his own strength and is not afraid of Luo Badao's tricks at all.After thinking about this, Luo Badao couldn't help but look at the seemingly ordinary young man in front of him with admiration.He has been around the world for more than ten years, from a small street gangster to the current black market boss, and has met all kinds of people.But this is the first time that someone as young as Chen Nan has such courage."I admire you." Luo Badao sighed secretly in his heart.Thinking back to when I first started out, I had to turn over the money and count it three times every time I made a transaction, for fear of suffering a small loss.And this young man can be so calm and calm when faced with a huge sum of more than 2,000 yuan. This determination is really amazing."Little brother Chen Nan," Luo Badao's tone unconsciously carried a hint of respect, "If there are any more pumpkins in the future, you can come to me." He paused and then added: "Not just pumpkins, but any food."
